recipe.visualDefinition: A high-key studio portrait of an eight-member musical ensemble dressed in vibrant red stage outfits, positioned against a stark white background with bold, stacked typography featuring flame and stencil motifs at the top center.
coreVisualRelationships: Vibrant red monochromatic clothing against a neutral white void
Stacked typography anchoring the top vertical third
Dynamic, slightly varied poses creating a rhythmic horizontal line
Warm flame gradients in the top text echoing the red of the costumes
coreInvariants: High-key lighting with minimal floor shadows
Monochromatic red wardrobe for all subjects

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The group occupies the lower half of the frame in a wide horizontal row; subjects are full-body scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, grey stencil-style text in the upper center acts as the primary weight.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the flaming title, drops to the large stencil name, and then scans the group from left to right across their varied poses.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space in the upper half and around the subjects creates a clean, isolated studio feel.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pure white background providing high contrast.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant scarlet red used for all clothing and the flame effect.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Neutral medium grey for the primary band name text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds against zero saturation in the background; medium value for the grey typography.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab serif and stencil sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Top line: Heavy sans-serif with irregular flame-like extensions on the top edges
Bottom line: Thick slab-serif with stencil-style gaps in the strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the top row feature a yellow-to-red vertical gradient with airbrushed flame silhouettes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A decorative illustrative title paired with a heavy, industrial stencil sub-headline.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the heavy, blocky stencil aesthetic of the main name.
Provides the necessary density for the flaming title line.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A wide-angle studio photograph of a diverse group of eight people in 1970s red disco suits and dresses, posing joyfully on a seamless white background with soft floor shadows and film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place two lines of centered text in the upper third. Top line: heavy sans-serif with a red-to-yellow flame gradient and flame shapes on top. Bottom line: large grey stencil slab-serif.

verificationChecks: Is the background pure white with no horizon line?
Does the text have a stencil effect?
Is there a flame effect on the top text line?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individuals
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the red clothing is vibrant and saturated.
Check that the white background is blown out but retains soft shadows at the feet.
Verify the stencil gaps in the typography are clean.
Confirm the flame effect looks like 1970s airbrushing rather than realistic CGI fire.
Ensure the grain texture is consistent across the image.
recipe.reuseFormula: Take a [subject group] in [monochromatic color] outfits, place in a [high-key white studio], and anchor with [stacked heavy stencil typography] featuring [thematic illustrative effects].
